answer: Gas-history gating ties every agent to an Ethereum wallet that has paid real fees for a long time. First, the agent signs a fresh nonce with that wallet. Next, the verifier scans mainnet and demands 12 months of activity plus 0.05 ETH burned in gas. Then each wallet may back just one agent, and its rewards echo back to that same address. Faking 1,000 agents costs about $150,000 in burned gas at $3,000 per ETH, plus a year of waiting no money can skip. A sybil swarm ends up like a nebula: huge and glowing from afar, yet with almost no mass once the tide of scrutiny rolls in.
